offence_note: Robbery, assault with knife, masked face with intent
sentence_quote: I sentence Mr. Paul as follows: 1. To 5 years’ custody to be served consecutively to the sentence he is currently serving.
note: Five years consecutive to a sentence already being served; Gladue report filed but not discussed.

offence_note: Sexual interference with 15-year-old; breach of undertaking
sentence_quote: a fit, just, and proportionate sentence would be one of 16 months' incarceration, and I impose that sentence on Count 1, the s. 151 offence
note: Four months concurrent on breach; SOIRA 20 years; s. 161 order declined.

offence_note: First degree murder (youth sentence) and two conspiracies to commit murder
sentence_quote: On December 10, 2007 the appellant was sentenced to seven years of imprisonment and five years of imprisonment for two conspiracies to commit murder
note: Youth murder sentence 4y2m custody plus 4y supervision; adult conspiracy terms consecutive; 17y2m is effective actual term per CSC.

sentence_quote: I will, therefore, impose a conditional sentence order of 18 months.
note: Prohibition on operating vehicle leasing business; house arrest with curfew.

sentence_quote: we would uphold the 12 month sentence on the gun offence and in light of the time spent in pre-trial custody (1½ months X2) we would convert the sentence on the hashish charge to a concurrent sentence.
note: Brief endorsement; hashish sentence originally consecutive, made concurrent; its length not shown.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm (single punch, broken orbital bone)
sentence_quote: the appeal from sentence is allowed. The sentence imposed in the trial court is set aside. A suspended sentence with two years' probation on the terms and conditions I have addressed is substituted.
note: Four months jail plus 12 months probation replaced by suspended sentence; 100 hours community work is probation condition.

offence_note: Attempted murder with firearm, firearm possession, flight from police
sentence_quote: the judge imposed a sentence of nine-and-a-half years' imprisonment for the offence of attempted murder, four years for possessing a loaded, prohibited firearm, and 12 months each
note: Credit 1.5:1 for pre-sentence custody; about 7y 4.5m left to serve; concurrent sentences.

offence_note: Making child pornography by secretly videotaping step-daughter
sentence_quote: satisfied that a term of imprisonment of two months is appropriate. I am also satisfied that should be served as a conditional sentence.
note: Five months jail replaced by two-month conditional sentence; probation bars cameras and females under 18; time in jail counted toward house arrest.

offence_note: Aggravated assault with knife on former husband
sentence_quote: On the count of aggravated assault, I sentence you to three months (or 90 days) of imprisonment, followed by three years (or 36 months) of probation.
note: Intermittent weekends; mitigating factors partly inferred from excerpts (immigration consequences, responsibility, no risk).
